At least Gifted. A master manipulator who can weaponize her situation to sway even those with good heads and kind hearts to her side. Her persuasion abilities rival that of The Joker and she has been able to pull off feats such as taking over an entire prison, causing a large amount of teenagers to support her, and convince the public that she was innocent. In terms of combat, she's shown to be reasonably skilled in fighting, able to go toe-to-toe with Nightwing, Harley Quinn, Batgirl, and even Batman, using her wits to stay one step ahead of her opponents.
Overconfident in her abilities often has her fight foes much stronger than her. Furthermore
